recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x prior middle/base divergence x top-then-other-lower initiators), against the checked-in board surface. Construction through checkpoint 22 is inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. Only the immediate second whole-group single=false rotation by the other lower logical index 1/2 is retained as the measured transition.

provenanceClaims.claim: Plain-R keyboard ingress requests whole-group rotation for the selected other lower card and forwards its logical index.
Top-then-other-lower single=false turn mutation, sibling rotation, unchanged per-card BREAK flags, selected-card margin rewrite, and action payload used by this capture.
Clicked middle/base-card ingress resolves the containing zone and logical index 1/2 used by rotate-card.
